summary.text: Greg Schwartz is a Democratic state representative from the 12th Middlesex District who has held the seat since January 1, 2025 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is a physician.

paragraphs.text: Greg Schwartz earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard College and an M.D. from Yale University in 1998, and his career experience includes working as a physician at Mass General and Brigham and Women's Hospital.
He succeeded Ruth Balser in the 12th Middlesex District seat in 2025.

In the 2025-2026 session his committee assignments include the House Global Warming and Climate Change Committee and the Cannabis Policy, Economic Development and Emerging Technologies, and Emergency Preparedness and Management joint committees.
